title: SHEQ & Office Coordinator
description:
SHEQ & Office Coordinator

£35,000 Monday to Friday Metal Recycling

Some people love doing the same job every day.

This isn't one of those jobs.

One day you'll be looking after the SHEQ side of the business.

The next, you could be helping with contracts or lending a hand with the accounts.

If you've worked in a smaller manufacturing business before, that'll probably sound quite familiar.

Because that's how smaller businesses work.

Everyone mucks in.

And that's exactly the sort of person they're hoping to find.

The current SHEQ Manager is starting to wind down towards retirement after many years with the business, so they're looking for someone to come in, learn the role properly and eventually take ownership of the SHEQ side.

There'll be a handover, so you won't be left to figure it out on your own.

Alongside SHEQ, you'll become an important part of the wider office team. Depending on your experience, that could mean supporting with contracts administration or helping the accounts team.

The role will naturally play to your strengths.

This isn't about trying to squeeze three jobs into one.

It's about finding someone who's happy being part of a small team, enjoys variety and likes knowing that what they do makes a difference.

As SHEQ & Office Coordinator, you'll already understand how manufacturing businesses work.

You know that keeping paperwork up to date, making sure compliance is in order and supporting the wider team are all just as important as what happens out on the shop floor.

As SHEQ & Office Coordinator, you'll be working alongside people who genuinely care about the business. It's a friendly team, people help each other out and there's a real sense that everyone is pulling in the same direction.

You'll probably recognise yourself here:

You've worked in manufacturing, engineering, recycling or a similar industrial environment.

You've had responsibility for SHEQ, Health & Safety or compliance as part of your role.

You're organised, approachable and happy juggling different priorities.

You enjoy variety and would soon get bored doing the same thing every day.

You're the sort of person who gets things done without making a fuss.

What's in it for you?

£35,000 salary.

Monday to Friday working.

A proper handover from the current SHEQ Manager.

A varied SHEQ & Office Coordinator role where no two days are the same.

A supportive team who'll value your experience and ideas.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Project Coordinator

An established and growing organisation within the construction sector is looking to appoint a Project Coordinator to join their team based in Stoke-on-Trent.

This is an excellent opportunity for a highly organised individual who enjoys managing multiple projects, liaising with customers, and working across several departments to ensure projects run smoothly from initial order through to completion.

The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in supporting the sales function, maintaining strong customer relationships, and ensuring project milestones are delivered on time.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide day-to-day support to Regional Sales Managers and the wider commercial team.
- Coordinate projects throughout their lifecycle, from order placement to successful completion.
- Act as a key point of contact for customers, providing updates and resolving queries in a timely manner.
- Monitor project progress
- Liaise with internal departments
- Prepare quotations, project documentation, reports and customer communications.
- Maintain accurate records within CRM and business systems.
- Organise meetings, track actions and ensure follow-up activities are completed.
- Produce regular project updates and performance reports for management.
- Contribute to the ongoing improvement of internal processes and project workflows.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will be a proactive and organised professional with excellent communication skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience within a Project Coordinator, Project Administrator, Sales Support or similar role.
- Knowledge of the construction industry, building products, or related sectors.
- Experience using CRM and/or ERP systems.
- An understanding of project delivery processes and customer requirements.
- Strong organisational and administrative skills with exceptional attention to detail.
- The ability to coordinate multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.
- A customer-focused approach and a solution-driven mindset.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office applications.

Qualifications & Skills
Essential
- GCSEs (or equivalent) including Maths and English at Grade 4/C or above.
- Previous experience in an administrative, sales support, customer service or project coordination environment.
- Strong IT literacy, including Microsoft Office applications.

Desirable
- Degree qualification in Business, Project Management, Construction Management or a related discipline.
- Knowledge of construction products, systems or specifications.
- Familiarity with technical documentation and project-related information.
- Experience working with CRM or ERP platforms.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary of 27,000 - 29,000.
- 26 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Stable Monday to Friday working hours.
- Opportunity to join a growing and successful business.
- Supportive team environment with opportunities for development and progression.

If you're a highly organised coordinator who thrives on keeping projects on track and delivering excellent customer service, we'd love to hear from you.

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

By applying for this role your details will be submitted to Adecco. Our Candidate Privacy Information Statement explaining how we will use your information is available on our website.
